sources.title: Prithvi-Precip: Integrating Satellite Observations into an Atmospheric AI
sources.snippet: Architecture of the final Prithvi-WxC Precip model to forecast precipitation using satellite observations. Observations encoded using the observation encoder shown in Fig. 3 are merged with the encoded model by calculating a residual correction using a two-layer MLP applied token-wise to the concatenated latent model state and observations.
